summary.plain: The international group of scientists and engineers who build and run the KM3NeT neutrino telescopes in the Mediterranean Sea.
summary.technical: KM3NeT Collaboration: international collaboration operating the KM3NeT deep-sea neutrino research infrastructure (ARCA and ORCA); described on its own site only as 'hundreds of scientists, engineers, technicians worldwide', with no precise, dated institute/country/member counts found on an official page this session. Its legal entity, KM3NeT AISBL, became operational in 2026.
